findings.note: In 2025-26 Johnson had 22 points and averaged 13:14 of ice time. He was scratched twice and went 7 and 10 games at a time without a point, though his shooting percentage was well below his career mark.

Columbus's 2026-27 opening roster has a crowded forward group, including Coyle, Monahan, Nichushkin, Knies, Garland and Fantilli, so Johnson may not get top-six or power-play time. His line and minutes for this game were not confirmed.
ESPN posted a clip of Johnson scoring a goal for Columbus on October 17, 2026. So he is playing and has scored this season, which cuts against an Under on 0.5 points.
